name: io.github.kanaworksai-hue/audio-studio-mcp
title: Audio Studio
description: Generate local BGM, sound effects, and songs with vocals using Stable Audio 3 and YuE2

runtimeArguments.name: --python
runtimeArguments.description: uvx may pick the newest Python, which PyTorch 2.7.1 (Windows) has no wheels for yet

runtimeArguments.name: --torch-backend
runtimeArguments.description: Windows: install the CUDA build of PyTorch (PyPI only has CPU builds). No effect on macOS

environmentVariables.name: AUDIO_STUDIO_SA3_MODEL
environmentVariables.description: Model: medium (default, best quality), sm-music or sm-sfx (small and fast)

environmentVariables.name: AUDIO_STUDIO_IDLE_UNLOAD_MIN
environmentVariables.description: Minutes without a request before the model is freed from memory (0 = never)
